ai.title: Client-side log shipper mirrors CLI logs to the /api/logs sink
ai.summary: A new client-side shipper in `cli/src/utils/log-shipper.ts` mirrors CLI log records into the server's `/api/logs` sink via `POST /api/logs`, running alongside PostHog and flushing on a 10-second interval or on process exit. The CLI logger in `cli/src/utils/logger.ts` feeds it through a new `enqueueClientLog` call that skips debug logs and only ships once a `userId` is present, with an `CODEBUFF_SHIP_LOGS` toggle that defaults to on outside dev/test. Shared packages define the wire schema (`common/src/schemas/logs.ts`), the `LogRow` contract (`common/src/types/contracts/logs.ts`), and a `buildLogRows`/`truncateData` ingest helper (`common/src/util/log-ingest.ts`) guarded by body and data byte caps. The change is best-effort and batched: a full buffer of 1000 drops the oldest record, unauthenticated batches are requeued up to `MAX_BUFFER`, and POST errors drop the batch rather than retrying.
ai.evidence: New `cli/src/utils/log-shipper.ts` ships CLI logs to `POST /api/logs`; `cli/src/utils/logger.ts` calls `enqueueClientLog` for non-debug log records; `cli/src/types/env.ts`/`cli/src/utils/env.ts` add `CODEBUFF_SHIP_LOGS`; `common/src/schemas/logs.ts`, `common/src/types/contracts/logs.ts`, `common/src/util/log-ingest.ts` define the ingest schema, LogRow contract, and `buildLogRows`.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show the server-side `/api/logs` handler that consumes the schema, nor the rollout status of the Axiom ingest endpoint.

changes.what: Added client-side log shipper and wired the CLI logger to enqueue log records for the `/api/logs` sink.
Added the shared log ingest schema, LogRow contract, and buildLogRows/truncateData helper.
Added analytics events for the logs ingest API auth and validation errors.

ai.title: Base-chat spawns thinker-gemini, reasoning links to agent Id
ai.summary: The `base-chat` agent can now spawn `thinker-gemini` as a subagent, with `instructionsPrompt` directing it to delegate reasoning tasks such as math, debugging, and architecture trade-offs to that subagent. `thinker-gemini` gains a `displayName` of `Thinker` and increases `reasoningOptions.effort` from `low` to `medium`. The reasoning chain now exposes the reasoning agent's stable `agentId` on `reasoning_delta` events instead of a `runId`, so SDK consumers attribute each reasoning delta to the correct agent.
ai.evidence: agents/base-chat.ts adds `thinker-gemini` to `spawnableAgents` and adds a paragraph to `instructionsPrompt` directing the chat agent to spawn it for reasoning tasks; agents/thinker/thinker-gemini.ts adds `displayName: 'Thinker'` and raises `reasoningOptions.effort` from `low` to `medium`; common/src/types/print-mode.ts adds `agentId` to `printModeReasoningDeltaSchema` and packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/stream-parser.ts emits `agentId: agentState.agentId` on `reasoning_delta` events; sdk/src/run.ts maps `chunk.agentId` instead of `chunk.runId` on `reasoning_chunk` events.

ai.title: Expand gemini-thinker parent models and refine prompts
ai.summary: Added MiMo 2.5 Pro and MiniMax M3 to FREEBUFF_GEMINI_THINKER_PARENT_MODELS in freebuff-models.ts, expanding deep reasoning availability to all full-access models except limited tiers. Updated system, instruction, and step prompts in freebuff-gemini-thinker.ts to broaden trigger conditions from "complex problems" to "problems worth thinking through," explicitly including non-trivial bugs and uncertain approaches. The CLI and server use this set to toggle spawnability and admit child requests, while the legacy Fastest MiniMax M2.7 remains excluded to preserve latency.

eli5.text: If you pick a smart model in the assistant, it can now call on a special reasoning helper for harder problems, and that helper is triggered by a wider range of situations (not just the toughest puzzles, but also tricky bugs and uncertain approaches). Two recently added full-access models join the supported list, so more capable options can use the helper, while the fastest budget-friendly model stays excluded to keep things quick. What you'd notice: when you choose one of the newer full-access models, the assistant will offer the deeper-thinking mode more often than before.

entries.summary: CLI, Shared/Core changes across 3 file(s) (+324/−100).

ai.title: Model picker collapses to a recommended hero and Freebuff model
ai.summary: The CLI model picker now opens collapsed on the landing screen to the recommended model (getRecommendedFreebuffModelId) as a single RECOMMENDED hero card, so a new user can start with one Enter press, with a "See all N models" toggle revealing the rest grouped into PREMIUM and UNLIMITED sections using the shared keyboard-navigation list keyed by TOGGLE_ID. common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts hoists the data-collection caveat to the FREEBUFF_DATA_COLLECTION_WARNING constant and derives FREEBUFF_TRACED_MODEL_IDS from it, so a model shows the picker warning and is stored in free mode as one fact, with MiniMax M3 explicitly excluded since it is served by Fireworks with no provider-side training. The waiting-room landing heading becomes the LANDING_HEADING constant 'Start coding for free' and the session quota counter is hidden until at least one session is consumed, changes that feed the picker's row-budget math (selectorMaxHeight). Three files changed in all (cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx, cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx, common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts), plus tests asserting these facts.
ai.evidence: In cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx the picker gains a collapse/expand toggle (TOGGLE_ID = '__freebuff_toggle__') that opens collapsed to the getRecommendedFreebuffModelId() hero on the landing screen and reveals PREMIUM/UNLIMITED sections on demand; in cli/src/components/waiting-room-screen.tsx the landing heading becomes the LANDING_HEADING constant 'Start coding for free' (replacing 'Pick a model to start') and the session quota counter is gated on usage, both feeding selectorMaxHeight; in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts the data-collection warning is hoisted to FREEBUFF_DATA_COLLECTION_WARNING and FREEBUFF_TRACED_MODEL_IDS derives storage from it, with getRecommendedFreebuffModelId/isFreebuffTracedModelId exported.

changes.what: Collapses the landing picker to a single recommended hero card and adds an expand/collapse toggle (TOGGLE_ID) that reveals grouped PREMIUM/UNLIMITED sections within the shared keyboard-navigation list.
Replaces the inline landing heading with the LANDING_HEADING constant and hides the session quota counter until at least one session is used, feeding the picker's selectorMaxHeight budget.

Hoists the data-collection caveat to FREEBUFF_DATA_COLLECTION_WARNING, derives FREEBUFF_TRACED_MODEL_IDS from it, exports getRecommendedFreebuffModelId and isFreebuffTracedModelId, and excludes MiniMax M3 from tracing by omitting the warning.

ai.summary: CLI release package bumped to 0.0.109. Version increment in freebuff/cli/release/package.json.

eli5.text: The latest version of the coding assistant tool is now packaged and ready to install as a new release. Updating to this release bundles together a set of recent improvements, most noticeably a change to how the model selection menu works: when you launch the assistant, the list of available AI models now appears collapsed, showing only the recommended option at the top, so new users can get started with a single press of the Enter key. The release also adds a few other refinements, such as the ability to switch the lightweight mode to use a different AI model, and includes fixes to how the assistant logs certain activities and how it references specific versions of models from other providers. Because this is a standard version bump tied to publishing the collected work of the past days, you would only notice these changes after updating to the latest installed version of the tool.
